en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden country hotel building in a rural valley with mountains in the background. A flagpole with a Scandinavian-style flag stands in front, with a few people and a horse‑drawn cart by the entrance. Decorative text at the bottom identifies the hotel, and along the right edge there is vertically printed holiday greeting text. The design and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
